summary: The board is permanently fixed at 64 squares, so the 249984 ordered placements of three distinct pieces form the complete legal input domain and cannot support asymptotic runtime scaling.

workload_bound.source_constraint: all three pieces occupy distinct squares of a fixed 8 by 8 board

replacement_checks.evidence: The solution evaluates only fixed row, column, diagonal, and strict-betweenness relations for one placement.
The certificate regression compares all 64 times 63 times 62 legal placements with an independent directional ray oracle.
